Publication policy

A deliberately limited public view.

Who appears

The initial edition includes only people whose master record contains explicit death evidence.

What is withheld

Living and uncertain people, free-text notes, private identifiers, raw genealogy data, guestbook content and unreviewed photographs are excluded.

Relationships

A family relationship is shown only through people independently eligible for publication. Withheld people are not named or represented as placeholders.

Future additions

Older uncertain records, notes and photographs can be added only through an explicit review and approval decision.
